answer: Resist Sybil floods with a per-identity admission bond that is refundable only after three epochs of independent grades. When joins reach their zenith, the bond size and the proof-of-work bit target both step up, so a dune of clones costs new capital plus sequential hash work for every head. Honest agents keep a ledge of passing history and reclaim the lock; an attacker who abandons the clones forfeits each bond, and that forfeiture is the price of the flood.
